data_fields.name: km_switch_m
data_fields.donor_constant: 999 (metres before the label switches to kilometres)

data_fields.name: north_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.0 (units ahead on y for the north pseudo-target)

data_fields.name: camera_fallback_norm
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.01 (J axis length below which the K axis is used)

best_idea: Show one bearing arrow and a distance label to the current target, measured against a switchable reference (player facing or camera direction), where the target can be a live tracked point, a fixed point, or north.
decision_why: The readout and the camera-or-facing switch fit a client-only HUD and the third-person camera; the (0,0) no-target sentinel is replaced by null in our version.
acceptance: With the compass in camera mode, a waypoint 100 m ahead reads '100 m - Waypoint' and the arrow points at it; orbiting the camera turns the arrow and turning the player does not; a waypoint at world (0,0) still shows.
